reason: For something like a plumber or a tutor I ask in the residents' WhatsApp group and go with who my neighbour vouches for -- that has worked fine for me, so I don't see why I'd start downloading some new app for a person I still don't actually know.
objection: What happens if the fellow doesn't turn up or does a shoddy job -- do I really get my money back, or is that just something written on the screen? I've called a JustDial number before and gotten a dead line, so I don't hand over trust to an app's promise until I've seen it work for someone I know.
would_change_my_mind: If two or three people in my building actually used it, got a refund when a job went bad, and showed me on their phone how it works, I might try it once.
